signal: A stacked PR was classified solely by matching base branch ref to another open PR head ref; no comparison of base.sha with parent head.sha
observed_scope: Source-level provenance omission; no observed malicious GitHub API response or production incident
root_cause: Dependency identity was branch-name bound but not commit bound
impact: Potential false confidence that stacked PR dependency metadata is coherent when parent/head SHAs disagree; no merge is approved by audit
acceptance: All three new cases plus existing suite pass on exact-head CI, authenticated API audit succeeds or honestly reports BLOCKED; drift is marked requires-review rather than merge-ready
rollback: Governed revert of these three isolated commits in this owned branch; preserve original records
recurrence: Reopen on absent base SHA acceptance, mismatched base/head SHA classified STACKED, missing tests or SHA mismatch
